definitions.explanation: A formal suggestion or recommendation, typically made by an expert, committee, or advisory body to those in authority. More formal and weighty than a casual suggestion.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}が{提言|ていげん}をまとめた。
{委員会|いいんかい}は{政府|せいふ}に{改革|かいかく}を{提言|ていげん}した。
examples.english: The committee proposed reforms to the government.

examples.japanese: {環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}に{関|かん}する{提言|ていげん}が{報告書|ほうこくしょ}にまとめられた。
examples.english: Recommendations regarding environmental issues were compiled in a report.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {提|てい} (present, put forward) + {言|げん} (words). Used as a suru verb ({提言|ていげん}する) to formally propose or recommend. Common in politics, business, and academic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {提言|ていげん}をまとめる (to compile recommendations)
- {提言|ていげん}を{行|おこな}う (to make a proposal)
- {政策|せいさく}{提言|ていげん} (policy recommendation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {提案|ていあん}: proposal — more general, used in everyday business and conversation
- {助言|じょげん}: advice — personal guidance rather than formal recommendations
